method: AI contextual translation review by the primary agent and independent review by the version-picker agent; not native-speaker certification.
scope: Best 50 began with Splash PLUS. Earlier rating formats are not supported.
checks: The imported-version label preserves the literal provider version and its placeholder.
The earlier-version notice explains the unsupported historical rating model without claiming historical scores can be reconstructed.
Forget wording describes removal of the browser's player data, covering both temporary scores and saved connections.
Official release names, Best 50 and Rating terminology remain consistent with the existing catalog.
visual_validation: Localized closed and open version controls are covered at 640, 320 and 280 CSS pixels. This review record does not itself assert those browser checks passed.
